channel.title: Midnight blog
channel.description: 记录软件从需求、架构设计、开发、测试到发布、运维与持续改进的工程实践，讨论具体约束、方案取舍和验证方法。AI 是工具链的一部分。

item.title: 放进 requestIdleCallback，为什么长循环仍会挡住页面？
item.description: 用四项有界队列解释空闲预算为何不会自动打断同步工作，区分未运行页面与已执行的超时策略纯函数。

item.title: CTest 只选一项测试，怎样让它的准备和清理也被执行？
item.description: 选中消费者时自动带入fixture准备与清理，用失败准备和独立日志验证执行集合。

item.title: RUN 的 bind mount 加了 rw，生成文件为什么下一步不见了？
item.description: 用构建内外两条输出路径验证RUN bind写入寿命，保留只读失败和stage来源对照。

item.title: check-ignore 对已跟踪文件没输出，怎样核对它会匹配哪条规则？
item.description: 分开读取忽略规则与索引，用no-index诊断已跟踪路径，并识别否定模式的verbose输出。

item.title: Base64 Strict 为什么仍接受输入里的换行？
item.description: 用正确尾位、错误尾位、CRLF 和无填充输入，核对 Strict 的具体边界；Go 程序未执行。

item.title: OpenFile 加 O_CREATE 后，旧文件后半段为什么还在？
item.description: 以独立临时文件的完整内容预期，区分创建、从头覆盖、截断与追加；Go 程序尚未执行。

item.title: ReadAt 读过 cd，下一次 Read 为什么还从 ab 开始？
item.description: 用交错读取和部分 EOF 预期区分随机访问、顺序游标与显式 Seek；Go 程序未执行。

item.title: fieldset 写了 form，里面的输入为什么还没进表单？
item.description: 分别检查外部fieldset与两个输入的form owner和FormData，解释分组关联不继承及显式无匹配ID的覆盖。

item.title: HTTP 414：为什么正文清空后，长查询仍被拒绝？
item.description: 固定ASCII目标串比较三种本地输入，区分目标URI与正文容量，并说明重复414需要哪些响应来源证据。

item.title: JSON reviver 为什么先处理子字段，再把对象交给父回调？
item.description: 以完整回调轨迹和父层快照解释reviver后序处理，区分返回当前值、删除字段与数组索引留下缺项。

item.title: String.raw 里插入换行，为什么结果仍有真正的换行？
item.description: 用完整代码单元序列区分模板固定段与已求值插值，检查raw保留了什么，以及缺少替换值时如何连接。

item.title: 字符串能存下来，isWellFormed 为什么仍是 false？
item.description: 逐代码单元对照两个孤立代理与一个正确代理对，说明FFFD替换不可恢复原字符，并检查URI编码消费者的新条件。

item.title: Deployment 镜像已经改了，暂停状态下为什么没有新发布？
item.description: 把暂停期间的模板修改与恢复后的发布身份分开核对；集群示例未运行。

item.title: 同一条 PR 曲线，AP 为什么不等于梯形面积？
item.description: 三条固定排序样本分别算出AP六分之五与梯形面积二十四分之十九，保留阈值方向与独立并列分数条件。

item.title: 测试还没结束，怎样先撤掉这一段 monkeypatch？
item.description: 用块作用域及时恢复补丁，核对正常、异常与嵌套所有者，并保留故意失败的反例。

item.title: fullmatch 限定了窗口，^ 为什么仍看原字符串开头？
item.description: 用原位置、切片和换行控制，解释 fullmatch 窗口的起点锚点、虚拟末尾与坐标差异。

item.title: 只想抓当前函数，为什么另一个线程的 print 也进来了？
item.description: 以主动 join 的线程夹具区分全局输出替换、退出恢复和显式流；另验 stderr 的独立目标。

item.title: lower 后仍不匹配，casefold 为什么能找到 Straße？
item.description: 用 sharp-s 扩展、原文位置和规范组合控制，区分文本过滤的匹配成功与高亮定位。

item.title: ZINTER 里的 a 原分一和二，为什么结果变八？
item.description: 用独立整数预期和逆序反例，说明 ZINTER 先加权再聚合，并区分零权重与成员资格；Redis 未执行。

item.title: RestartPreventExitStatus 阻止重启，会把失败也改成成功吗？
item.description: 区分停止自动重启与成功退出分类，用相同退出值的两份教学单元解释结果；Linux未执行。

item.title: Why can a long loop still block inside requestIdleCallback?
item.description: Use a four-item queue to explain cooperative idle budgets, separating an unexecuted page from an executed timeout-policy fixture.

item.title: How can a selected CTest test bring its setup and cleanup along?
item.description: Verify fixture setup and cleanup added for selected consumers, including failed preparation and independent logs.

item.title: Why do files written to a writable RUN bind mount vanish in the next step?
item.description: Verify RUN bind-write lifetime with separate output paths, a read-only failure, and a stage-source control.

item.title: How can check-ignore explain a rule match for an already-tracked file?
item.description: Diagnose ignore patterns separately from index state, including verbose negated-pattern output.

item.title: Why does Base64 Strict still accept a newline?
item.description: Check valid bits, invalid bits, CRLF and unpadded forms against the precise Strict contract in an unexecuted Go fixture.

item.title: Why does O_CREATE leave the old suffix after a shorter write?
item.description: Distinguish creation, overwriting, truncation and append with independent full-content oracles in an unexecuted Go fixture.

item.title: Why does Read start at ab after ReadAt returned cd?
item.description: Separate offset reads, sequential progress and explicit Seek with interleaved byte and short-read oracles; Go fixture unexecuted.

item.title: Why can inputs remain outside a form after their fieldset gets a form attribute?
item.description: Inspect the owners of an external fieldset and its inputs, then test an unmatched explicit form override inside a form.

item.title: HTTP 414: why can a long query still fail after the body is emptied?
item.description: Compare three local ASCII-target cases, distinguish URI length from content capacity, and identify evidence needed for repeated 414 responses.

item.title: Why does a JSON reviver visit children before their parent?
item.description: Trace child deletion and the parent snapshot, then inspect a new array-index case without confusing deletion with compaction.

item.title: Why can a String.raw result still contain an actual newline?
item.description: Compare literal segments and evaluated substitutions by exact code units, then inspect an ordinary call with fewer substitutions.

item.title: Why can a stored string still fail isWellFormed?
item.description: Inspect lone and paired UTF-16 surrogates by exact units, distinguish replacement from recovery, and test a new URI-encoding consumer.

item.title: Why does an updated image not start a rollout while a Deployment is paused?
item.description: Correlate paused template edits with the resumed rollout identity; the cluster fixture is unrun.

item.title: Why can AP differ from trapezoidal area on the same PR curve?
item.description: Derive AP of 5/6 and trapezoidal area of 19/24 from three ranked examples, then inspect a separate tied-score condition.

item.title: How can you restore a monkeypatch before the test ends?
item.description: Restore scoped patches before teardown and verify normal, exceptional, and nested-owner behavior.

item.title: Why does ^ still use the original string origin in a fullmatch window?
item.description: Check original spans, sliced spans and real-newline controls to distinguish bounded matching from a new string origin.

item.title: Why does redirect_stdout capture another thread too?
item.description: Separate global capture, restoration and explicit streams with a controlled joined worker and an independent stderr check.

item.title: Why can casefold match Straße when lower cannot?
item.description: Separate caseless matching from original-text highlighting using expansion, offset and canonical-composition controls.

item.title: Why is a ZINTER score eight when the inputs were one and two?
item.description: Use independent integer oracles and a reversed-order control to explain weighting before aggregation; Redis commands unexecuted.

item.title: Does RestartPreventExitStatus turn a failed exit into success?
item.description: Separate restart prevention from successful-exit classification with two same-exit fixtures; Linux execution remains unrun.

item.title: validate_only 返回成功，为什么资源还没变？
item.description: 用相同成功回应和不同存储状态区分预览与执行，保留权限检查、请求标志和后续读取证据。

item.title: aria-pressed 变了，静音按钮为什么还叫 Mute？
item.description: 用稳定Mute名称对照按下态与教学静音状态，说明另一命令标签方案，并限定mixed的新条件。

item.title: pointer-events:none 的父容器，为什么还能收到子按钮点击？
item.description: 把子按钮命中与祖先捕获冒泡分开读，用两处物理点击位置验证pointer-events的范围。

item.title: 测试等设备很久，真正开始后怎样另算超时？
item.description: 用准备标记切换 CTest 超时，分别验证快、慢与未命中分支，并保留预检失败。

item.title: 远程文件下载成功，Docker 怎样确认内容还是预期那份？
item.description: 固定批准摘要，用正确与一位错误值构建，再读回导出文件；下载成功之外还需内容身份检查。

item.title: Git 说文件是 LF，编辑器为什么仍看到 CRLF？
item.description: 分别读取 Git 索引和磁盘字节，对照换行报告的内容列与属性列，定位真实交付输入。

item.title: range 顺序会变，Marshal 的 map JSON 为什么仍按键排好？
item.description: 对照不同赋值顺序的普通 map，检查 Go JSON 编码排序及整数键先转文本的条件。

item.title: 两个 Time 表示同一瞬间，map 为什么收成两把键？
item.description: 对照地点不同的同一瞬间，核对 Time.Equal、结构相等及统一键后的 map 身份。

item.title: setRangeText 文本一样，为什么选区位置不同？
item.description: 比较同一局部替换的三种选区模式，保留文字与两端偏移，区分编辑结果和后续输入位置。

item.title: defineProperty 只写 value，新字段为什么不能改也列不出？
item.description: 对比描述符新建与字面量字段的值、标志、键列表和写入结果，区分新建与更新条件。

item.title: split 用正则括号后，分隔数字为什么也进了数组？
item.description: 逐项比较捕获与非捕获分隔结果，解释捕获项怎样占用limit，并检查未参与的捕获。

item.title: revisionHistoryLimit 已是零，为什么旧 ReplicaSet 还在？
item.description: 先核对 Deployment 本轮完成状态，再解释零历史保留与旧 ReplicaSet 的关系；集群演练待执行。

item.title: 目标全是5，R²为什么默认只得到0或1？
item.description: 用SSE与SST解释常量目标的非有限R²及默认替换，保留参数和有限零分反例。

item.title: 想测已安装的包，pytest 为什么只把包名当路径找？
item.description: 从源码目录外按包名运行 pytest，核对解释器、安装来源与测试节点，识别同名本地副本。

item.title: 同一个 hash 轮流加 A 和 B，为什么第二份摘要串上了 A？
item.description: 用独立完整字节重算，对照 hash 状态复制、别名累计与读取摘要后的继续更新。

item.title: 新值比堆顶还小，heapreplace 为什么仍把旧值赶走？
item.description: 对照零与四进入两个相同最小堆后的弹出值和保留集合，并检查空堆启动条件。

item.title: product 还没取第一项，为什么输入已经读完了？
item.description: 按构造与首次读取时点观察有限来源，核对完整组合及零轴和空轴的区别。

item.title: 头字段只有两字节，unpack 为什么拒绝更大的完整帧？
item.description: 比较固定二字节头的精确缓冲和偏移读取，检查短头、载荷边界与固定记录余数。

item.title: LPOS 从尾部找，为什么仍返回正向下标？
item.description: 用三个重复标记对照 LPOS 的正负匹配次数、原列表坐标及 MAXLEN 有限范围。

item.title: ProtectSystem=strict 下，服务该往哪里写自己的状态？
item.description: 用受管理状态目录保留必要写入，以同身份普通路径的 EROFS 对照检查保护；Linux 运行待复验。

item.title: Why can validate_only succeed while the resource remains unchanged?
item.description: Compare equal success responses with different stored states and retain permission checks, request mode, and later reads.

item.title: Why does a mute toggle keep the Mute label when aria-pressed changes?
item.description: Compare a stable Mute label with pressed and teaching mute states, and distinguish that design from changing action labels.

item.title: Why can a pointer-events:none ancestor still observe its child’s click?
item.description: Distinguish an auto child hit from its ancestor event path, with capture and bubble logs and two physical click locations.

item.title: How can CTest give the active phase its own timeout after waiting?
item.description: Verify a CTest timeout transition with fast, slow, and unmatched branches, preserving failed preflight assumptions.

item.title: How can Docker ADD verify the expected content after a remote download?
item.description: Pin an approved digest, exercise matching and one-character-wrong builds, and verify exported bytes beyond download success.

item.title: Why can Git report LF while the working file contains CRLF?
item.description: Read index and disk bytes independently to interpret Git EOL content fields and conversion attributes.

item.title: Why does Marshal sort map keys despite varying iteration order?
item.description: Check ordinary map encoding against a fixed text oracle, including integer-to-string key conversion.

item.title: Why does a map keep two Time keys for the same instant?
item.description: Compare Equal, structural equality, and normalized map keys for two location representations of one instant.

item.title: Why can setRangeText produce the same text with different selections?
item.description: Compare three selection modes for one replacement and retain the text plus both endpoints before the next editing action.

item.title: Why can a new defineProperty value resist writes and disappear from key lists?
item.description: Compare new descriptor and literal properties through values, flags, keys, and writes, with creation and update treated under their own conditions.

item.title: Why do separator digits appear after splitting with a capturing regex?
item.description: Compare capturing and noncapturing split results, count captures against the limit, and inspect an unmatched capture.

item.title: Why can old ReplicaSets remain with revisionHistoryLimit zero?
item.description: Check current Deployment completion before interpreting zero history and remaining ReplicaSets; cluster execution is unrun.

item.title: Why can constant targets make the default R² score only zero or one?
item.description: Explain non-finite constant-target R² through SSE and SST, retain the replacement parameter, and compare a finite zero.

item.title: How do you tell pytest to test an installed package by name?
item.description: Run pytest by package name outside its checkout and verify interpreter, installation origin, and collected tests.

item.title: Why did the second hash include the first suffix?
item.description: Check copied prefix branches against complete byte inputs, an alias contamination control, and a later update after digest observation.

item.title: Why does heapreplace evict the old minimum for an even smaller input?
item.description: Compare returned and retained values for two incoming scores, then verify the empty-heap startup condition.

item.title: Why has product consumed its input before the first output?
item.description: Observe a finite source at construction and first-read boundaries, then distinguish zero axes from one empty axis.

item.title: Why does unpack reject a complete frame larger than its two-byte header?
item.description: Compare exact and offset header decoding, a short header, payload boundaries, and incomplete fixed records.

item.title: Why does a reverse LPOS search still return a head-based index?
item.description: Compare occurrence rank, head-based positions, reverse result order, and a limited MAXLEN search.

item.title: Where can a systemd service write state with ProtectSystem=strict?
item.description: Keep necessary state writes in a managed directory and check an EROFS control with the same identity; Linux execution remains unrun.

item.title: AIP-160 的 a AND b OR c，为什么先合并 OR？
item.description: 用八行真值表解释AIP筛选的OR优先级，识别会掩盖错分组的样本，并写清接口语法范围。

item.title: outline 加粗后，为什么旁边按钮没有移动？
item.description: 区分轮廓墨迹与布局占位，用宽度切换页同时检查目标矩形、邻居位置和实际指示。

item.title: CTest 开了并行，怎样让共用一台设备的两项测试不撞车？
item.description: 用原子资源标记和执行区间核对 CTest 的同名资源锁，并明确它的调度范围。

item.title: 同一构建上下文，怎样只让其中一次 COPY 排除文件？
item.description: 从同一上下文导出完整与精简文件集，验证单条 COPY 的排除范围及必须保留的输入。

item.title: normalize 后文字没变，Text 引用为什么脱离了容器？
item.description: 用三只文本节点合为一只的页面解释内容不变、身份与父子关系变化，并核对旧引用的用途。

item.title: 两份导出都不在 Git 仓库里，怎样查看它们的改动？
item.description: 直接比较仓库外的两份导出，结合真实缺路径回执核对补丁、诊断与状态的边界。

item.title: CSV Reader 为什么把第二行判成字段数错误？
item.description: 比较 Go CSV 默认学习、显式两列和关闭宽度检查，核对第一条记录对后续格式的影响。

item.title: Trim 想删 .zip，为什么把合法字母也删了？
item.description: 用 zipup.zip 对照 Go 字符集合清理与完整前后缀删除，检查合法主体是否完整保留。

item.title: copyWithin 右移重叠区间，为什么不会一路复制成 A？
item.description: 用AABC与错误AAAA对照重叠复制方向，同时核对原数组身份、长度和覆盖合同。

item.title: padStart 用 ab 补三位，为什么得到 aba？
item.description: 从aba7解释重复填充前缀，核对短值、等长与超长输入，并区分显示补位和编号校验。

item.title: PostStart 里生成配置，为什么主进程仍可能先读不到？
item.description: 对照 PostStart 并发准备与显式串行入口，检查容器第一次读取是否已经拿到配置。

item.title: GroupShuffleSplit 设一半，为什么测试行数不是一半？
item.description: 用四组十二行区分组比例和样本比例，保存同次划分的组交集、组数与行数。

item.title: 配置了 pytest testpaths，为什么还能跑到目录外的测试？
item.description: 用两个测试目录对照 pytest 的默认入口和显式路径，并保存真实节点身份。

item.title: 两个 gzip 字节串接起来，解压为什么得到两段内容？
item.description: 对照两段 gzip 的独立恢复、拼接恢复和后半 CRC 错误，核对完整字节与单成员替代入口的条件。

item.title: 两笔流水，accumulate 为什么输出三个余额？
item.description: 核对期初、逐笔后状态与事件编号，复现 zip 长度正常却对齐错误的路径。

item.title: partial 绑定 timeout 后，调用时为什么还能改掉它？
item.description: 对照关键字覆盖、位置参数冲突和保存字典的修改，核对 partial 真正交给原函数的参数。

item.title: 集合没有重复成员，SRANDMEMBER 为什么回了三次 A？
item.description: 用单成员固定预期和多成员不变量核对 SRANDMEMBER 的正负 count、重复槽位与来源集合。

item.title: 触发器又写了两行，changes 为什么还只返回一？
item.description: 在隔离 SQLite 事务里检查一次直接插入与两条触发器审计，并核对回滚后的两表状态。

item.title: 服务写了 /tmp 文件，宿主终端为什么读不到同一路径？
item.description: 从宿主和服务分别读写同名临时标记，解释 PrivateTmp 的文件可见性与停止清理边界。

item.title: 摇动撤销已有按钮，为什么还要能关闭摇动？
item.description: 用撤销版本四格模型区分替代按钮与停用运动响应，给出产品复验路径和计步功能的新条件。

item.title: Why does AIP-160 group OR first in a AND b OR c?
item.description: Use eight Boolean rows to explain AIP filter precedence and distinguish matching results from a correct grammar implementation.

item.title: Why does a thicker outline leave the neighboring button in place?
item.description: Separate outline ink from layout space and compare target geometry, neighbor position, and the rendered indicator.

item.title: How can CTest keep two tests off the same device during a parallel run?
item.description: Verify a named CTest resource lock using an atomic marker and execution intervals, with explicit scope boundaries.

item.title: How can one Docker COPY exclude a file while another still includes it?
item.description: Export full and reduced file sets from one context to verify per-instruction Docker COPY exclusion and required contents.

item.title: Why can normalize detach a Text reference while leaving the text unchanged?
item.description: Trace three Text nodes becoming one while the content stays AB, and inspect what saved references represent afterward.

item.title: How can Git compare two exports outside a repository?
item.description: Compare two exports outside a repository and interpret patch, diagnostics, and status using an observed missing-path result.

item.title: Why does a CSV Reader reject the second row's field count?
item.description: Compare inferred, explicit, and permissive CSV widths and trace the first record's effect on later rows.

item.title: Why does Trim remove letters when I only wanted to remove .zip?
item.description: Compare cutset trimming with literal prefix and suffix removal and protect the complete filename body.

item.title: Why does copyWithin avoid turning an overlapping right shift into all A values?
item.description: Compare AABC with an incorrect AAAA result and check overlap direction, array identity, length, and the overwrite contract.

item.title: Why does padStart use aba when three padding units are needed?
item.description: Explain aba7 through the repeated filler prefix, compare short and overlong inputs, and define the role of a display identifier.

item.title: Why can an entrypoint miss configuration created by PostStart?
item.description: Compare concurrent PostStart preparation with an ordered entrypoint and verify the application's first configuration read.

item.description: Check the embedding chain and distinguish permission from capture, then assign late streams to request generations and explicit cleanup.

item.title: Pass-Through Playwright Routes Still Change HTTP Cache Tests
item.description: Pass-through routing still disables HTTP cache. Design unrouted cold and warm image visits, distinguish Service Workers and status evidence, and bound unroute claims.

item.title: Why Explicit NULL Does Not Use a PostgreSQL Column Default
item.description: Trace omission, DEFAULT, and NULL through SQL, non-null rejection, updates, mixed-version defaults, and historical repair.

item.title: Why does OR IS NULL fail to restore a LEFT JOIN customer?
item.description: Use four customer groups to distinguish matching, filtering, null extension, detail counts, and absence queries.

item.title: Why Descending Time Order Puts Missing Timestamps First
item.description: Specify PostgreSQL descending null placement, per-column direction, and ties with four rows separating order, eligibility, and cross-page guarantees.

item.title: Why Prometheus increase can be fractional for integer counters
item.description: Audit a paper calculation of 6.25 against a fixed implementation, then distinguish extrapolation, zero constraints, resets, aggregation, and reconciliation.

item.title: Why can two pytest.approx tolerances allow a larger error?
item.description: Inspect alternative tolerance budgets, abs-only behavior, near-zero cases, and unit conversion using a fixed pytest version.

item.title: Reject overload without turning recovery into the next traffic surge
item.description: Connect bounded admission, deadlines, truthful degradation and retry budgets, then readmit backlog progressively with explicit side-effect and fairness checks.

item.title: Who should revoke a Blob URL while its preview is still in use?
item.description: Use a single-owner preview controller to explain creation, replacement, release, shared addresses, persistent artifacts, and separate download acceptance.

item.title: 确认页写已提交，怎样让用户知道接下来等什么？
item.description: 用一笔假设申请串起接收、排期、补证据和决定，区分提交未知、通知排队、会话结束与回执时间变化的恢复责任。

item.title: 伙伴门户已获准，最上层页面为什么仍会阻断嵌入？
item.description: 用三个本地来源的未执行 fixture 逐层检查 frame-ancestors，并区分父页加载、真实响应交付、self 与用户授权。

item.title: Docker只发布到localhost，还应检查哪些访问路径？
item.description: 用明确回环与未指定绑定的声明，核对旧版本二层例外、双栈和路由模式，再区分既有实例、默认创建配置、Swarm与应用授权。

item.title: 错误摘要能点击，为什么仍改错一条记录？
item.description: 沿家庭成员日期纠错走完摘要、定位、修改与重提，按GOV.UK指导选择复合答案目标，并处理删除、重排和迟到错误的归属。

item.title: Git stash后文件还在，哪些内容没有被暂存？
item.description: 用三份同初态练习仓库比较默认、-u与-a，核对条目身份、部分暂存和恢复冲突，明确本地保存与备份的边界。

item.title: 输入框禁用了，提交时为什么收不到原来的值？
item.description: 比较原生FormData与手工对象，补充fieldset继承、布尔属性、readonly范围和禁用时机。

item.title: 收到 HTTP 405，应该修改方法还是检查目标资源？
item.description: 用完整本地服务与请求矩阵定位资源和方法差异，分开授权、代理入口、跳转与可缓存旧错误，不以 GET 成功替代写入。

item.title: 事故级别应该看告警数量，还是看实际用户影响？
item.description: 用完整假设决策记录替代告警计数，解释影响不明时的临时判断、协调需求，以及恢复后残留工作的分级边界。

item.title: Date.parse没写时区，纯日期和日期时间为何不同？
item.description: 用完整跨TZ进程脚本比较纯日期、无偏移日期时间与明确Z形式，分开解析、展示和字段语义。

item.title: JSON.stringify 后字段消失，undefined 应该改成 null 吗？
item.description: 用完整 JSON 文本与纯函数补丁矩阵区分对象省略、数组 null、顶层 undefined 和保持清空协议，检查自定义转换与真实请求边界。

item.title: Kubernetes Service 入口不变，新旧 Pod 怎样使用不同目标端口
item.description: 用旧新 Pod 双端口示例解释稳定 Service 入口、命名 targetPort 和全部 EndpointSlice 的分层验证。

item.title: 把环境变量false解析成启动契约：关闭、缺失与拼写错误分别处理
item.description: 用严格布尔解析器、合法与非法输入矩阵和假服务工厂，验证配置错误会在资源创建前失败；再区分运行实例与Worker采用新值的时点。

item.title: 用内存导出检查批次追踪：父级、三条链接与单条重试
item.description: 用实际Python内存导出核对三来源批次与B单条重试，分开父级、链接、业务结果和目标可见性，并说明HTTP环境上下文边界。

item.title: Playwright下载事件来了，文件为什么还是丢了？
item.description: 补充完整下载保存测试，区分事件、临时文件、saveAs、内容验收和CI留存，并说明远程path限制。

item.title: COUNT(*) 和 COUNT(字段) 为什么给出不同数量？
item.description: 用部门申请报表对齐 PostgreSQL 行数、非空联系方式与不同申请人数，检查左连接占位行、空文本和附件扩行。

item.title: 两条不同事件值相同，UNION 为什么会少算？
item.description: UNION 比较整个投影行，不推断事件身份。用四条独立事件推演两行三十与四行五十，再区分来源列、业务去重和限制子句的作用范围。

item.title: Prometheus 出现 exported_job，哪一方标签被保留下来了？
item.description: 用本地端点与两份抓取策略追踪 Prometheus job/instance 冲突，区分来源、查询身份和 external_labels。

item.title: pytest 看不到 INFO 时，怎样判断日志丢在哪一层？
item.description: 用一个可运行的导入测试区分 logger 门槛、传播和 caplog 阶段。用返回值、批次编号和负对照检验日志归属。

item.title: HTTPS 报表页会把哪些地址信息放进 Referer？
item.description: 同一个报表地址分别打开三个接收入口，核对来源头的路径、查询和源，以及如何判断请求是否真的抵达。

item.title: URLSearchParams把加号变空格，原始值该从哪一层传入？
item.description: 补充加号、空格、百分号与重复键的完整查询往返，区分原始值、编码文本和原始串身份。

item.title: After submission, what should a confirmation page tell users to wait for?
item.description: Follow a hypothetical application through receipt, scheduling, evidence requests, and decision, with distinct recovery for unknown submission, notifications, and revisits.

item.title: Why can an outer page block framing after the partner portal is allowed?
item.description: Work through an unexecuted three-origin framing fixture, distinguishing full-ancestor permission, parent loading, actual response delivery, self, and user access.

item.title: What paths still need checking when Docker publishes only to localhost?
item.description: Compare explicit loopback and unspecified bindings, retain older-version and dual-stack routing conditions, and inspect defaults, existing instances and Swarm separately.

item.title: Why can a working error-summary link still reach the wrong answer?
item.description: Follow a household date correction through summary, targeting, editing, and resubmission; apply GOV.UK composite-answer guidance and handle removal, reordering, and late responses.

item.title: Why are files still present after git stash?
item.description: Compare default, -u and -a in independent identical fixtures, inspecting entry identity, partial staging, recovery conflicts, and backup scope.

item.title: Why does a disabled field disappear from form submission?
item.description: Compare native FormData with manual collection, including fieldset inheritance, boolean attributes, readonly scope and timing.

item.title: Interpret HTTP 405 through the target resource contract
item.description: Diagnose 405 with a complete local route example while checking authorization, ingress, redirects and cached errors separately.

item.title: Should incident severity follow alert counts or user impact?
item.description: Replace alert counts with an illustrative decision record, covering uncertainty, coordination, and residual work after apparent recovery.

item.title: Date.parse without an offset: why do date-only and date-time differ?
item.description: Compare date-only, unoffset date-time and explicit-Z inputs with a complete fresh-process TZ script, separating interpretation, display and business meaning.

item.title: Should undefined become null when JSON.stringify drops a field?
item.description: Compare objects, JSON text and a complete pure patch policy to separate omission, array nulls, top-level undefined and retain-versus-clear semantics.

item.title: Keep a Kubernetes Service port stable while backend ports change
item.description: Trace a stable Kubernetes Service entry through named target ports, separate backend cohorts, and all related EndpointSlices.

item.title: Parse environment flags before startup: false, missing and invalid are different states
item.description: Use a strict boolean parser, valid and invalid input cases, and a fake service factory to verify pre-resource startup failure; distinguish that from effective configuration across instances and Workers.

item.title: Check batch tracing with an in-memory exporter before trusting the graph
item.description: Verify a three-source batch and B-only retry with an actual Python in-memory exporter, separating parentage, links, business outcomes and target visibility.

item.title: Why is a Playwright download lost after its event fires?
item.description: Join download events, explicit saving, content validation and CI retention, including remote path limitations.

item.title: Why PostgreSQL COUNT(*) and COUNT(column) disagree
item.description: Align PostgreSQL row, non-null-contact, and applicant counts in a department report, checking outer-join placeholders, empty text, and attachment fan-out.

item.title: Why can UNION undercount different events with equal values?
item.description: UNION compares complete projected rows rather than inferring event identity. Four independent events expose two rows totaling thirty versus four totaling fifty, source-key effects and separate ordering/LIMIT decisions.

item.title: Which label wins when Prometheus creates exported_job?
item.description: Trace Prometheus job/instance conflicts with a local exporter and two scrape policies, preserving provenance and query identity.

item.title: Where did an INFO record disappear in pytest?
item.description: Use a runnable import test to distinguish logger thresholds, propagation and caplog stages. Verify attribution with a return value, batch identifier and negative controls.

item.title: What does an HTTPS report page send in Referer?
item.description: Three receiving endpoints show which address fields the referrer can contain and how to tell whether the browser sent the request.

item.title: Where should raw values enter URLSearchParams to preserve plus signs?
item.description: Trace complete query round trips for plus, space, percent and repeated keys without confusing values with serialized text.

item.title: 申请电话工单关了，怎样证明材料已补齐并提交？
item.description: 以电话转现场的住址证明补件为例，检查草稿、材料和提交回执，找出工单关闭后仍可能中断的步骤。

item.title: Docker 默认日志驱动已改，为什么旧容器仍用原配置？
item.description: 用容器编号、实际日志配置和独立事件检查，区分 Docker 默认值已更新、实例已替换和日志链路可用。

item.title: Fetch 的 bodyUsed 还是 false，为什么读不了正文？
item.description: 用三个本地响应区分正文锁定、已读和克隆，并为业务解析与诊断指定明确的消费顺序。

item.title: forEach 里写了 await，外层为何提前结束？
item.description: 用可控的本地例子观察 forEach 的返回值，再按任务依赖选择逐项等待、并行汇总或逐项记录结果。

item.title: 分支推送成功，发布标签为什么还没到远程？
item.description: 用临时接收仓库对照三次推送，解释如何选择标签并核对发布回执。

item.title: HTTP 204 成功后，为什么不该继续解析 JSON？
item.description: 用本地 HTTP 服务对照 204 和两种 200 响应，区分保存成功、返回元数据与 JSON 解析异常。

item.title: GET 请求带了筛选正文，为什么服务链路未必理解？
item.description: 用本地 Request 构造解释 GET 正文的客户端边界，再核对查询身份、缓存和兼容期输入。

item.title: 多语言列表排序，为什么需要明确 Collator 的语言？
item.description: 用德语和瑞典语的本地对照，明确语言协商、比较平局与可重复名单的边界。

item.title: Kubernetes Job 重试次数，为什么不能只数失败 Pod？
item.description: 用明确虚构状态对照失败 Pod 与活动容器重启，并按执行身份组织诊断与恢复证据。

item.title: Map 里存过对象，换一个相同对象为什么找不到？
item.description: 用本机核对的十项结果区分对象引用、业务编号与 undefined 成员状态，并明确跨刷新选择的范围和失效规则。

item.title: npm 开了 ignore-scripts，为什么 npm test 仍会运行？
item.description: npm CLI 11.9.0 的实测显示，ignore-scripts 会跳过安装脚本和 pre/post 钩子，但显式 npm test 仍执行目标脚本。

item.title: OAuth 回调在同一域名下，为什么仍要精确匹配？
item.description: 同域名不等于同一接收端点。RFC 9700 要求精确匹配 OAuth 回调，并限定原生应用本地回环端口例外。

item.title: Span 已结束，进程退出前还需要刷新导出吗？
item.description: 有序退出通常等待 provider 关闭完成；分清主动刷新与关闭清理，也别把导出成功误当成后端持久化。

item.title: Playwright 重试通过后，第一次失败还要保留吗？
item.description: 测试重试转绿不等于首次失败已修复。按 Playwright 的 worker、trace 保留模式与尝试编号，决定留下哪些证据。

item.title: 空数组的 array_length 为什么是 NULL？何时该用 cardinality
item.description: array_length 回答指定维度有多长，cardinality 回答总共有多少元素。理解空维度、缺失维度和 SQL NULL，才能避免过滤与业务状态被悄悄改写。

item.title: PostgreSQL RETURNING 返回行，就代表事务已提交吗？
item.description: RETURNING 描述一条修改语句返回的行；显式事务仍须等 COMMIT 成功，外部消息也另有交付边界。

item.title: Prometheus 抓取更频繁，告警为什么不一定更快？
item.description: 抓取与评估周期分别控制不同阶段；沿事件到通知核对实际时间，不从单个参数承诺延迟。

item.title: pytest 没捕获到输出，应该选 capsys 还是 capfd？
item.description: 先看写入边界，再确认快照时刻：capsys 观察 Python 流，capfd 观察文件描述符；子进程重定向仍需单独读取。

item.title: 重复工作都值得自动化吗？先判断它是不是 toil
item.description: 在消除需求、一次性工程改进与自动化之间比较；把正常执行、维护、复核和故障恢复都计入候选方案。

item.title: 速度和质量被放进同一道问卷题，结果该怎么解释？
item.description: 把响应速度与解决质量合成一次评分，会丢掉两者相反时的判断依据。本文说明如何拆题、试答、保留整体评价并处理历史可比性。

item.title: How can you verify a supported application actually reached submission?
item.description: Follow an application from phone support to in-person evidence collection and check the original draft, evidence and submission receipt.

item.title: Why does an existing Docker container keep its old logging driver?
item.description: Check the daemon default, actual container settings and a distinct diagnostic event to verify a logging migration.

item.title: Why can a Fetch body reject a read while bodyUsed is false?
item.description: Compare locked, disturbed and cloned local responses, then assign ownership for parsing and diagnostics.

item.title: Why does forEach finish before its async callbacks?
item.description: Run a local example that isolates the forEach return value, then choose sequential waits, parallel aggregation, or per-item outcomes.

item.title: Why is the release tag missing after a successful branch push?
item.description: Compare three pushes to a temporary receiver to choose release tags and verify the resulting refs.

item.title: Why should a successful HTTP 204 skip JSON parsing?
item.description: Compare a 204 and two forms of 200 on a local HTTP server, then distinguish save success, response metadata and decoding errors.

item.title: Why may a GET filter body fail across a service chain?
item.description: Observe local Request construction, then check query identity, caching and compatibility-period input rules.

item.title: Why should a multilingual list choose its Collator locale?
item.description: Compare German and Swedish locally to define locale selection, ties and the limits of repeatable list order.

item.title: Why do failed Pod counts miss Kubernetes Job retries?
item.description: Compare fictional failed-Pod and active-restart snapshots, then organize diagnostic and recovery evidence by execution identity.

item.title: Why does Map miss a new object with the same fields?
item.description: Ten locally checked outcomes separate object identity, business IDs and undefined membership, with scoped refresh and invalidation rules.

item.title: Why does npm test still run with ignore-scripts enabled?
item.description: A local npm CLI 11.9.0 fixture shows that ignore-scripts skips install scripts and pre/post hooks, while an explicit npm test still runs its target.

item.title: Why must OAuth callbacks match exactly, even on the same domain?
item.description: A shared hostname does not prove a shared receiver. RFC 9700 requires exact OAuth redirect matching, with a narrow native-app loopback-port exception.

item.title: A Span Ended. Should You Flush Before the Process Exits?
item.description: For orderly exit, usually wait for provider teardown. Understand its relation to ForceFlush, and why export success is not proof of backend persistence.

item.title: Keep first-failure evidence when Playwright retries pass
item.description: A green retry does not prove the first failure was fixed. Use worker identity, trace-retention modes, and per-attempt results to decide what evidence to keep.

item.title: Why Does array_length Return NULL for an Empty Array?
item.description: array_length measures one dimension; cardinality counts all elements. Distinguish an empty dimension, an absent dimension, and SQL NULL before filtering or changing business state.

item.title: PostgreSQL RETURNING Rows Do Not Necessarily Mean the Transaction Committed
item.description: RETURNING describes rows from a modifying statement. An explicit transaction still needs a successful COMMIT, and external delivery has its own boundary.

item.title: Why More Frequent Prometheus Scrapes May Not Alert Faster
item.description: Scraping and evaluation control separate stages. Trace the event-to-notification path before promising latency changes from one setting.

item.title: pytest Captured No Output: Should You Use capsys or capfd?
item.description: Choose by the write boundary and snapshot time: capsys observes Python streams, capfd observes file descriptors, and redirected subprocess pipes need their own reader.

item.title: Choose Automation Work by First Identifying Toil
item.description: Compare removing demand, durable engineering and automation while accounting for routine work, review, maintenance and recovery.

item.title: How should you interpret a survey rating that combines speed and quality?
item.description: A single rating for response speed and resolution quality hides which one needs attention. Learn how to split the question, test its meaning, retain a useful overall measure and handle trend breaks.

item.title: 核对页的“返回修改”不是导航问题，而是事务状态问题
item.description: 核对页的修改操作要保留同一任务、重算失效的后续答案，并把最终提交与浏览器返回、刷新和网络重试隔离。

item.title: Cookie 的 Path 只能缩小发送范围，不能隔离同源权限
item.description: Cookie Path 决定浏览器在哪些请求中附带值，不是授权或同源隔离边界。本文拆解路径匹配、同名 Cookie、迁移清理和服务端权限验证。

item.title: 容器 unhealthy，Docker 为什么没按策略重启？
item.description: Docker HEALTHCHECK 记录健康状态，restart policy 处理容器退出；本文拆解二者边界、Compose 启动依赖与可验证的恢复设计。

item.title: 错误预算耗尽后，先冻结哪些变更？
item.description: 错误预算是测量结果到变更决策之间的书面约定。先核对用户范围和消耗归因，再分级限制高风险动作，并写明例外、审批人及解除证据。

item.title: 把表单答案接到服务决策：一份字段协议要写清什么
item.description: 字段协议应说明答案由谁使用、改变什么决策、适用于哪些用户，以及如何校验、保留和删除。清楚的标签不等于有理由收集。

item.title: 写入 .gitignore 后仍被跟踪：先分清规则、索引和工作文件
item.description: .gitignore 只影响尚未跟踪的路径。用索引和工作目录分别确认状态，再决定如何停止跟踪、保留本地配置或处理已泄露秘密。

item.title: Accept 是偏好，不是保证：客户端如何核对实际 HTTP 响应
item.description: Accept 表达客户端愿意接收哪些表示；响应状态、Content-Type、正文语法和业务结构仍须分别检查，406 也不是服务器必须返回的结果。

item.title: 为什么解压后的正文长度可能和 Content-Length 不同？
item.description: 响应头长度以所选表示的八位字节为准；内容编码、HTTP/1.1 分帧与 JavaScript 字符串长度处在不同层，不能直接比较。

item.title: JSON 解析没报错，长编号为什么还是变了？
item.description: JSON 数字语法正确不保证长编号精确；在数值转换前保留身份，逐层核对而不从舍入值猜原文。

item.title: Always 仍下载很少，节点到底用的是不是新镜像？
item.description: imagePullPolicy: Always 会重新解析镜像引用，但可复用已缓存层；用 Pod 模板、imageID 与 rollout 证据判断发布版本。

item.title: 按钮透明了，键盘还在走：隐藏状态得同时管三条路径
item.description: opacity: 0 只改变视觉合成，不会自动停止点击或 Tab 焦点；应按单控件、整块区域和动画过渡选择真正的状态机制，并单独核对辅助技术路径。

item.title: 记录异常后，Span 为什么仍是 Unset？先判断这段操作是否失败
item.description: `recordException` 写入异常事件，不会自动把 Span 状态设成 Error。按 Span 的操作边界、最终结果和当前语义约定，决定是否记录异常、设置错误状态或保留 Unset。

item.title: 在 Playwright 里等用户任务，不要等网络安静
item.description: networkidle 只表示短暂没有网络连接，不代表结果已渲染或操作成功。按测试契约选择 URL、控件、业务结果或网络断言。

item.title: numeric(4,2) 会舍入多余位，为何 99.995 仍报越界？
item.description: PostgreSQL numeric(p,s) 先把值舍入到声明的小数位，再检查整数位容量。存储舍入不等于输入校验；两种拒绝规则需要在转换前区分。

item.title: PostgreSQL 序列出现空号，不能据此认定记录丢失
item.description: nextval 的分配不会随事务回滚回收，ON CONFLICT 和序列缓存也会留下空号。用已提交记录与业务状态排查，不要把主键当完成计数。

item.title: 记录规则有结果，原来的实例标签为什么不见了？
item.description: 记录规则输出的是新序列；聚合、向量匹配和标签覆盖都可能改变身份。按表达式、规则组与下游查询逐层排查。

item.title: 主任务成功了，finally 为什么仍能让调用链失败？
item.description: finally 清理抛错或拒绝会改变返回链的状态，但不能说明外部写入是否提交。分开记录主任务、清理结果和重试依据。

item.title: 标记 xfail 的测试恢复通过，为什么流水线仍可能放行？
item.description: 默认 XPASS 会被报告但不一定让套件失败。严格设置改变门禁，不证明断言仍覆盖原缺陷；按 pytest 版本核对配置并保留退出依据。

item.title: 登录后返回地址，怎样避免变成任意跳转入口？
item.description: 把登录回跳当成独立的导航信任边界：优先服务端目的地映射；确需 URL 时按解析后的组件许可，并把内部路径授权与失败落点分开。

item.title: 新标签页里的 sessionStorage，为什么会带着旧值？
item.description: sessionStorage 通常按源和标签页会话隔离，但有 opener 的新辅助上下文可以获得初始副本；要按任务身份区分新建与恢复，不按键是否存在决定。

item.title: An editable review page is a transaction-state problem, not a navigation problem
item.description: An editable review must preserve the same task, recalculate invalidated answers and separate final submission from browser history, refreshes and retries.

item.title: Cookie Path Narrows Sending Scope; It Does Not Isolate Same-Origin Permissions
item.description: Cookie Path determines which requests carry a value, not authorization or same-origin isolation. Learn the matching rules, duplicate-name risk, migration cleanup, and server-side checks.

item.title: Why doesn't Docker restart an unhealthy container?
item.description: Docker HEALTHCHECK records a health state, while restart policies act on container lifecycle events. Learn the boundary, Compose startup dependencies, and a verifiable recovery design.

item.title: Which Changes Should Stop When the Error Budget Is Exhausted?
item.description: An error budget is a written contract between measurement and change decisions. Verify scope and causes, restrict higher-risk actions, and define exceptions, approvers, and evidence for lifting restrictions.

item.title: Tie Each Form Answer to a Service Decision
item.description: A field protocol names who uses an answer, which decision it changes, which users need to provide it, and how it is validated, retained, and deleted. A clear label is not a reason to collect data.

item.title: A Path Is Still Tracked After .gitignore: Separate Rules, Index, and Worktree
item.description: A .gitignore rule applies to untracked paths. Check the index and worktree separately before choosing whether to untrack a file, keep local configuration, or respond to an exposed secret.

item.title: Accept Is a Preference, Not a Guarantee: How to Check the Actual HTTP Response
item.description: Accept states a client's preferred representations; status, Content-Type, body syntax, and business structure still need separate checks, and 406 is not mandatory.

item.title: Why can a decompressed body differ from Content-Length?
item.description: Response headers report octets at a representation layer; content coding, HTTP/1.1 framing, and JavaScript string length are different quantities.

item.title: Preserve long identifiers before numeric parsing loses precision
item.description: JSON number syntax can be valid while a long identifier loses distinguishable digits. Preserve identity before conversion and verify every boundary.

item.title: Always Still Downloads Very Little: Which Image Is the Node Running?
item.description: imagePullPolicy: Always resolves a reference again while reusing cached layers. Check the Pod template, runtime imageID, and rollout to verify a release.

item.title: The Button Is Transparent, but Tab Still Finds It: Hiding Must Change Three Paths
item.description: opacity: 0 changes visual compositing, not pointer targeting or keyboard focus. Choose the actual state mechanism for a control, subtree, or transition, and check assistive-technology exposure separately.

item.title: Why Is a Span Still Unset After Recording an Exception? Judge the Operation First
item.description: `recordException` adds an exception event; it does not set Span status to Error. Use the Span’s operation boundary, final outcome, and applicable semantic conventions to decide which signals to record.

item.title: In Playwright, Wait for the User Task, Not Network Silence
item.description: networkidle reports a brief lack of connections, not rendered results or task success. Choose between URL, control, business-outcome, and network assertions based on the test contract.

item.title: Why Does numeric(4,2) Round Extra Places but Reject 99.995?
item.description: PostgreSQL numeric(p,s) rounds to its declared scale before checking integer capacity. Storage rounding is not input validation; distinguish two rejection policies before conversion.

item.title: A PostgreSQL Sequence Gap Does Not Prove a Lost Record
item.description: Rollback, ON CONFLICT, and sequence caching can leave gaps. Diagnose them against committed rows and business state; do not treat a primary key as a completion counter.

item.title: A Prometheus Recording Rule Returned a Value—Why Did the Instance Label Disappear?
item.description: A recording rule writes a new series. Aggregation, vector matching and label overrides can change its identity. Trace the expression, rule group and downstream queries.

item.title: The Save Succeeded, but finally Rejected: What Should the Caller Retry?
item.description: A rejected finally cleanup changes the returned chain, but says nothing by itself about whether an external write committed. Separate operation, cleanup, and retry state.

item.title: An xfail Test Started Passing—Why Can CI Still Stay Green?
item.description: By default, XPASS is reported but need not fail the suite. Strictness changes the gate, not assertion validity; check configuration against the pytest version and retain removal evidence.

item.title: Validate redirect destinations as a navigation trust boundary
item.description: Prefer server-side destination mappings; when URLs are necessary, validate parsed components and keep navigation policy separate from authorization.

item.title: Understand per-tab storage without assuming a blank initial state
item.description: sessionStorage is usually isolated by origin and page session, but a new auxiliary context with an opener can start from a copy. Use task identity to distinguish fresh work from recovery.

item.title: 收到 429 后，什么时候重试才有依据？
item.description: 429 说明请求受到限流，不会替客户端决定重试次数。结合 Retry-After、请求副作用、取消和总时限，设定有上限的重试与清楚的结束状态。

item.title: 给 PUT 与 PATCH 加一张请求契约表
item.description: PUT 用请求表示目标状态，PATCH 按指定补丁格式应用修改指令。契约表核对省略字段、null、数组与版本冲突；并发条件和领域命令仍需单独设计。

item.title: npm audit fix --force 后报告变绿，就能直接发布吗？
item.description: npm audit fix --force 可能越过依赖版本范围。本文说明如何把报告、锁文件、兼容性验证与待发布产物连成可复核的发布判断。

item.title: 镜像中的文件换了，挂载卷里为什么还是旧内容？
item.description: Docker 只会在空卷首次挂载时默认复制目标目录内容；已有卷会遮住新镜像文件。本文给出核对挂载、迁移状态与安全回退的方法。

item.title: “陈旧”不是“关闭”：功能开关退役前要分清三个层次
item.description: 生命周期状态是清理信号，不等于应用运行状态或代码分支已移除。本文用一次假想折扣发布说明如何按消费者、回退和证据顺序退役功能开关。

item.title: Git bisect 找到一个提交，也可能留下未确定的根因范围
item.description: git bisect 的提交结论依赖一致的性质判定；构建错误、行为回归与跳过提交需要区分。本文说明退出码契约、候选边界和因果验证。

item.title: Git revert 留下反向提交，怎样确认代码真的恢复？
item.description: git revert 保留原提交并新增反向变化；核对提交树、合并父节点、构建产物与运行状态，才能说明恢复到哪一层。

item.title: await fetch 后还能用旧 IndexedDB 事务写入吗？先看它的状态
item.description: IndexedDB 请求处理完并回到事件循环后，旧事务可能自动提交；网络等待应放在短本地写事务之前。

item.title: 为什么调用 `sort()` 后，原数组的顺序也变了？
item.description: `sort()` 会修改原数组并返回同一引用；复制可保留容器顺序，但不会自动隔离数组中的记录对象。

item.title: CronJob 按时创建了 Job，就能保证业务只执行一次吗？
item.description: CronJob 不保证业务恰好一次；计划槽位、Job 尝试和业务周期各有身份。用稳定业务键与持久结果记录，使重复尝试可收敛、可恢复。

item.title: 日志里有 TraceId，就一定能打开完整链路吗？
item.description: TraceId 是关联身份，不是 span 已采集、导出、保留或对当前账户可见的收据。排查要分别核对上下文、采样、导出、查询范围和权限。

item.title: 每组只取一条记录，怎样确定拿到的是哪一条？
item.description: DISTINCT ON 需要明确组内优先级；代表行不是组汇总，并列与迟到数据要有选择依据。

item.title: NOT IN 为什么没有返回预期的未匹配记录？
item.description: NOT IN 遇到空值可能返回未知；先定义身份缺失的业务规则，再核对排除查询与改写等价性。

item.title: 时间字符串带偏移，数据库为什么没有按时区转换？
item.description: 时间输入偏移是否参与解释取决于类型；区分时间点、本地时间、显示时区与历史来源。

item.title: 指标消失了，为什么不能直接当作零流量？
item.description: 缺少样本不是零流量；根据预期目标检查采集覆盖，总体数值不能证明每个实例完整。

item.title: 实验室任务顺利，为什么还要观察用户自己的设备？
item.description: 用参与者自己的设备与材料识别任务环境，区分界面问题、协作等待与干扰，不把受控会话外推为日常保证。

item.title: 给 CDN 脚本加了 integrity，为什么仍加载失败？
item.description: SRI 同时依赖预期字节与跨源条件；哈希匹配不证明代码可信，更新和回退需要维护审查关系。

item.title: 测试替换了全局函数，怎样限制它影响的范围？
item.description: 限制全局补丁影响范围与恢复时机；恢复引用不回滚外部副作用，环境变量还需核对读取时机。

item.title: 固定 Date 以后，定时器为什么仍按真实时间运行？
item.description: 固定日期与推进定时器不同；核对安装顺序、版本与后端时间边界，仍需业务结果断言。

item.title: 用 URL 拼接口地址，末尾斜杠为什么会改变结果？
item.description: URL 按目录与源解析相对地址，斜杠影响路径；语法解析成功不能替代目的地授权。

item.title: Bound retries after a rate-limit response
item.description: A 429 signals rate limiting but does not choose a retry count. Combine Retry-After with replay safety, cancellation and an overall deadline to define bounded attempts and clear terminal states.

item.title: A contract table for PUT and PATCH updates
item.description: PUT uses a request representation to define target state; PATCH applies instructions in a specified format. The contract table covers omissions, nulls, arrays, and stale versions, while concurrency and domain commands need separate rules.

item.title: The npm audit report is green after --force. Is it ready to ship?
item.description: npm audit fix --force may cross declared dependency ranges. Learn how to connect the report, lockfile, compatibility checks, and release artifact before shipping.

item.title: Why does a mounted volume still show old files after an image update?
item.description: Docker copies destination files into an empty volume on its initial mount by default; an existing volume then obscures newer image files. Learn how to inspect mounts, plan migrations, and preserve safe rollback.

item.title: A stale flag is not an off switch: separate three layers before retirement
item.description: A lifecycle label is a cleanup signal, not proof that runtime behavior or source branches have changed. Follow a hypothetical rollout to retire a flag in dependency order, including consumer and rollback checks.

item.title: Git bisect can narrow the range and still leave the culprit uncertain
item.description: A bisect result depends on a consistent property predicate. Separate setup errors, behavior regressions, and skipped revisions before interpreting a boundary or making a causal claim.

item.title: Git revert records an inverse commit; how do you verify recovery?
item.description: A revert preserves the original and records an inverse change. Verify the tree, merge parent, built artifact, and runtime separately to state what actually recovered.

item.title: Can an old IndexedDB transaction still write after `await fetch()`? Check its state
item.description: After IndexedDB requests are handled and control returns to the event loop, an old transaction may auto-commit; keep network waits before the short local write transaction.

item.title: Why does `sort()` change the original array?
item.description: `sort()` mutates its array and returns the same reference; copying the container does not isolate its record objects.

item.title: Does a CronJob creating a Job guarantee the business runs only once?
item.description: A CronJob does not guarantee exactly-once business execution. Separate schedule slots, Job attempts, and business periods; use stable business keys and durable outcome records to make retries converge and recover.

item.title: Does a TraceId in a log guarantee a complete trace?
item.description: A TraceId is correlation identity, not a receipt that spans were collected, exported, retained, or visible to the current account. Check context, sampling, export, query scope, and authorization separately.

item.title: Define the representative row before using DISTINCT ON
item.description: Define representative-row precedence and validate ties and late arrivals before deduplication.

item.title: Keep null semantics visible in exclusion queries
item.description: Preserve unknown identity semantics when designing and rewriting exclusion queries.

item.title: Choose timestamp types from the meaning of the stored value
item.description: Choose timestamp storage from instant or local-time meaning and preserve original zone intent separately.

item.title: Treat missing telemetry separately from a measured zero
item.description: Keep missing telemetry distinct from measured zero and inspect expected target coverage.

item.title: Observe the task context beyond a controlled research session
item.description: Inspect real task constraints without treating a controlled session as everyday-use proof.

item.title: Keep integrity hashes, bytes and cross-origin permissions aligned
item.description: Align expected bytes and cross-origin permissions without treating integrity as code trust.

item.title: Limit monkeypatch scope and restore temporary dependencies
item.description: Limit patch scope and distinguish restored references from undone external effects.

item.title: Control date values and timer progression deliberately
item.description: Control date values and timer progression according to the behavior being tested.

item.title: Resolve relative URLs with an explicit base-path contract
item.description: Make base-path semantics explicit and keep URL parsing separate from destination permission.

item.title: 工作流被路径过滤跳过，为什么 PR 仍在等检查？
item.description: 工作流过滤跳过可能让必需检查待定；区分作业跳过与实际成功，让门禁对应当前提交和真实结果。

item.title: CSP nonce 应该跟着构建，还是跟着响应变化？
item.description: CSP nonce 按响应生成且与许可标签匹配；缓存和模板注入需共同检查，不对未知脚本无差别授权。

item.title: 容器停机信号为什么没到应用进程？
item.description: 先确认入口进程与信号交接，再评估停机时间；exec 改变清理责任，启动成功不证明结束正确。

item.title: 下载文件名为什么不能直接当作本地路径？
item.description: 下载文件名只是建议；分别控制保存目录、存储身份和内容处理，国际化解析不替代安全判断。

item.title: HEAD 返回 200，为什么仍需验证 GET 正文？
item.description: HEAD 成功不验证 GET 正文；结合访问条件核对内容、元数据和实际发布范围。

item.title: 故障处理中，谁来决定优先级和接手时机？
item.description: 故障管理明确指挥、操作、沟通与交接责任；假设、影响和恢复证据分开，兼任也需明确归属。

item.title: 配置 PDB 后，哪些中断仍然可能发生？
item.description: PDB 约束特定自愿中断，不能阻止节点故障或代替滚动更新策略；副本数量也不证明服务容量。

item.title: 网络分块切断中文字符，应该在哪一层处理？
item.description: 保留跨块字符的解码状态，再独立处理消息分帧、大小上限和输入结束；正确解码不代表消息完整。

item.title: write 返回 false 后，Node.js 流应该怎样继续？
item.description: write 返回 false 后等待 drain；highWaterMark 是阈值，背压与取消、缓冲预算及业务确认需要分别设计。

item.title: Delta 和 Cumulative 指标为什么不能混着相加？
item.description: Delta 与 Cumulative 的区间语义不同；保留起止时间、序列身份及重启处理，避免重复计算或假定缺失为零。

item.title: 改完密码，旧登录会话就一定失效了吗？
item.description: 密码恢复还需旧会话与恢复渠道策略；疑似失陷时核对控制权，不能仅以新密码可用宣布恢复。

item.title: 定位到两个按钮时，为什么不该直接加 first？
item.description: 定位器歧义先确认业务身份与区域；first 只选择位置，不证明目标正确，等待也不能消除身份问题。

item.title: 连接池里的 PostgreSQL 咨询锁，什么时候才会释放？
item.description: 咨询锁按会话或事务释放，连接归还不等于会话结束；检查重复取得、清理与外部副作用边界。

item.title: 计数器重启过，为什么要先 rate 再 sum？
item.description: 先对每条计数器求 rate，再汇总以保留重置信息；窗口、指标类型与实例排查需要分别解释。

item.title: 原型已经能用，为什么还不能直接上线？
item.description: 原型用于研究假设，生产承担真实数据与运行责任；逐项确认复用条件，不以可点击页面代替上线验收。

item.title: pytest 参数化测试为什么会互相改到输入？
item.description: 参数化不自动复制输入；核对共享对象、嵌套可变值和预期结果，避免只修复当前运行顺序。

item.title: useId 解决什么身份问题，又不能替代什么？
item.description: useId 用于可访问性关联，不替代列表键或业务主键；服务端渲染需两侧组件树一致。

item.title: 研究笔记怎样区分观察、解释和下一步行动？
item.description: 研究笔记把观察、解释与行动分开，保留原话出处和竞争假设，不把会议共识当作更多用户证据。

item.title: SQLite 声明了外键，为什么还要检查每条连接？
item.description: SQLite 外键需在每条连接确认执行，并在事务外配置；表定义和开启开关都不能证明历史数据正确。

item.title: 移动端看着正常，放大后为什么仍可能不可用？
item.description: 放大重排需保留信息与功能；分别检查手机和桌面放大，二维内容例外不覆盖整张页面。

item.title: Keep required checks observable when a workflow is filtered out
item.description: Keep required-check results tied to the current commit when workflows or jobs are skipped.

item.title: Scope a CSP nonce to the HTTP response that carries it
item.description: Generate response-scoped CSP nonces and keep policy, approved tags and caches consistent.

item.title: Make the container entrypoint hand off signals deliberately
item.description: Inspect entrypoint process ownership and signal handoff before evaluating shutdown budgets.

item.title: Treat a download filename as a suggestion, not a local path
item.description: Separate suggested download names from authorized destinations and permitted content handling.

item.title: A successful HEAD response does not verify the GET body
item.description: Verify GET content under the reader’s access conditions beyond successful HEAD metadata.

item.title: Assign incident command before parallel fixes collide
item.description: Coordinate incident roles, active changes and accepted handovers with explicit evidence limits.

item.title: Use a PodDisruptionBudget within its disruption scope
item.description: Review PDB disruption scope separately from rollouts, fault domains and service capacity.

item.title: Decode split text characters without confusing them with message frames
item.description: Preserve split-character decoding state, then apply independent framing and end-of-input rules.

item.title: Respect writable backpressure before sending more chunks
item.description: Respect backpressure and define cancellation, buffer budgets and business acknowledgment separately.

item.title: Preserve metric temporality before combining reported values
item.description: Preserve metric intervals and temporality across collection, conversion and restart boundaries.

item.title: Password recovery needs an explicit session-revocation policy
item.description: Define session and recovery-channel handling beyond acceptance of a new password.

item.title: Resolve locator ambiguity before choosing the first match
item.description: Resolve locator identity and scope before relying on positional selection or longer waits.

item.title: Advisory-lock ownership must match the connection lifetime
item.description: Match advisory-lock scope to pooled-session ownership and explicit cleanup boundaries.

item.title: Calculate each counter rate before aggregating replicas
item.description: Preserve counter-reset context by calculating per-series rates before aggregation.

item.title: A working prototype still needs a production boundary
item.description: Evaluate production responsibilities separately from the interaction a prototype helps study.

item.title: Avoid mutable aliases between parametrized test cases
item.description: Inspect mutable aliases and independent expectations instead of relying on test ordering.

item.title: Use React useId for accessibility relationships, not data identity
item.description: Use useId for accessibility relationships while preserving data identity and matching render trees.

item.title: Separate research observations from interpretations and actions
item.description: Keep observed research evidence, competing explanations and proposed actions distinct.

item.title: Verify SQLite foreign-key enforcement on each connection
item.description: Check foreign-key enforcement per SQLite connection before transactions, without assuming historical validity.

item.title: Test zoom reflow separately from a narrow mobile viewport
item.description: Verify information and operations after zoom reflow, keeping two-dimensional exceptions local.

item.title: 提交显示 Verified，就代表代码已经审查了吗？
item.description: Verified 说明签名验证，不能代替代码批准；把签名、审查、检查与部署分别绑定具体提交。

item.title: ConfigMap 改了，应用为什么还在用旧配置？
item.description: ConfigMap 更新与应用采用是不同阶段；区分环境变量、挂载与 subPath，并记录有效配置版本。

item.title: CORS 报错了，就能确定请求没有执行吗？
item.description: CORS 错误不能证明业务未执行；区分预检和响应读取，关联服务端证据并设计未知结果恢复。

item.title: POST 跳转后变成 GET，服务端到底接收了什么？
item.description: POST 重定向需要区分方法保留与结果展示；同时检查正文重放、目标边界和重复副作用。

item.title: 同一个网址，缓存为什么给错了语言版本？
item.description: Vary 参与缓存表示匹配；核对语言、默认分支与代理输出，并分别审查私人数据和授权边界。

item.title: 页面流程通了，用户为什么仍卡在部门交接处？
item.description: 页面操作成功不等于用户任务完成；从跨部门交接、材料接收与责任归属识别旅程断点。

item.title: 覆盖率很高，测试为什么仍放过错误的比较符？
item.description: 变异存活提示测试敏感性问题；逐项核对业务含义、输入缺口与断言，避免只为分数绑定实现细节。

item.title: 用了 npm ci，就能保证两台机器产物完全相同吗？
item.description: npm ci 冻结安装不等于构建完全复现；记录运行时、参数与配置，先定义产物允许哪些差异。

item.title: CHECK 写着大于零，为什么空值仍能保存？
item.description: CHECK 为真或空值都可满足；把必填、数值范围与业务阶段分别定义，避免把未知批量改成零。

item.title: RLS 策略写好了，为什么应用仍能读到所有租户？
item.description: RLS 是否生效取决于运行角色和策略；区分高权限绕过、表所有者及读写路径，不以管理员查询代替验收。

item.title: SKIP LOCKED 查不到任务，就代表队列空了吗？
item.description: SKIP LOCKED 的空结果不代表队列清空；分别记录领取、完成与恢复，并检查顺序和公平性需求。

item.title: VACUUM 完成了，数据库文件为什么没有变小？
item.description: 普通 VACUUM 主要让空间复用，FULL 重写有额外空间和锁成本；按容量目标选择维护与验收指标。

item.title: 多个实例的 P95，为什么不能直接取平均？
item.description: 实例 P95 不能直接平均成整体 P95；先定义请求总体、窗口与指标形式，再审查分布聚合和局部问题。

item.title: 随机输入测了很多次，怎样知道断言没有写错？
item.description: 属性测试还需要独立正确性依据；审查业务属性、输入领域和关键案例，不把大量生成当作证明。

item.title: 可以算出的 React 状态，为什么还要用 Effect 同步？
item.description: React 派生值通常在渲染时计算；区分独立编辑、外部同步与性能优化，避免维护多份重复状态。

item.title: 关闭动画以后，用户还能看出操作状态吗？
item.description: 减少动态效果仍需完整状态反馈；分别检查运动、文字、脚本实现与会话中偏好变化。

item.title: 正则能校验输入，为什么也可能拖住服务？
item.description: 正则校验也需要资源边界；结合模式、引擎和输入规模审查失败路径，核对处理预算能否真正停止工作。

item.title: 同意参加访谈，就能把录音交给任何工具吗？
item.description: 研究同意需要关联录音、转写与分享副本；引入外部工具前核对用途、接收方与退出路径。

item.title: structuredClone 以后，原来的 buffer 为什么不能用了？
item.description: transfer 会改变资源使用权；在接口中明确原持有者、异步失败和重试数据的责任。

item.title: Webhook 的 JSON 没变，签名为什么校验失败？
item.description: Webhook 签名针对原始请求内容；先核对中间件、端点秘密与字节，再分别设计去重和完成记录。

item.title: A verified signature is not a code-review receipt
item.description: Bind signature verification, review, checks and deployment evidence to their exact commits.

item.title: Configuration delivery and application reload are separate events
item.description: Trace ConfigMap consumption, propagation and effective application versions across environment and volume boundaries.

item.title: A CORS error does not establish that the server did nothing
item.description: Locate the CORS failure stage and correlate server outcomes before deciding whether a side-effecting action can be retried.

item.title: Redirect status codes carry a request-method contract
item.description: Choose redirect semantics from submission intent, then inspect body replay, destinations and duplicate effects.

item.title: A URL alone cannot identify every cached representation
item.description: Match cached representations against actual selection fields, including defaults and proxies, with separate privacy checks.

item.title: Map the handoff beyond a successful page flow
item.description: Inspect cross-team ownership, evidence acceptance and truthful status beyond a successful page flow.

item.title: Use surviving mutants to inspect assertion gaps
item.description: Interpret surviving mutants against business behavior and input gaps before adding implementation-coupled assertions.

item.title: A frozen install is only one input to a reproducible build
item.description: Inventory runtime, options and configuration beyond frozen installation, then define permitted artifact differences.

item.title: A CHECK constraint is not a required-value declaration
item.description: Separate CHECK ranges, required values and business stages without converting unknown data into false zeroes.

item.title: Test row security with the actual application role
item.description: Verify RLS with the runtime role, separating privileged bypass, ownership and read-write paths.

item.title: An empty SKIP LOCKED result is not an empty queue
item.description: Distinguish empty claims from completed queues and define durable ownership, recovery and ordering requirements.

item.title: Reusable database space is different from a smaller file
item.description: Distinguish reusable space from file shrinkage and assess rewrite capacity and access costs before maintenance.

item.title: Aggregate distributions before estimating a fleet quantile
item.description: Define the population, window and distribution representation before estimating a fleet quantile.

item.title: Property tests still need an independent behavioral claim
item.description: Review independent properties, meaningful domains and explicit boundaries rather than treating generated input volume as proof.

item.title: Calculate derived values before introducing synchronized state
item.description: Separate derived display values, independent edits and external synchronization before storing another state copy.

item.title: Reduced motion still needs clear state feedback
item.description: Keep clear operation states while reducing motion across styles, scripts and preference changes.

item.title: Regular-expression validation needs an execution budget
item.description: Review regex pattern, engine and input size together, including whether resource limits actually stop processing.

item.title: Research consent needs a traceable data-use boundary
item.description: Trace research consent through recordings, transcripts and recipients before introducing another processing tool.

item.title: Transferring a buffer changes ownership rather than making a second copy
item.description: Define buffer ownership, original-holder access and retry recovery before choosing transfer over copying.

item.title: Verify webhook signatures before changing the request body
item.description: Verify original webhook bytes and endpoint secrets before parsing, with separate deduplication and completion records.

item.title: OIDC 不再保存长期密钥，谁还能换到云权限？
item.description: OIDC 减少长期密钥保存，仍需限定工作流身份与云权限；核对新仓库 subject 格式和环境审批路径。

item.title: Prometheus 每轮都超标，for 为什么仍在重新计时？
item.description: 把实时值写进告警label会更换实例身份；用连续超限时间线、annotation迁移和通知层分组解释pending为什么不累积。

item.title: Deployment 滚动更新完成，业务验收为什么仍未结束？
item.description: Deployment 更新完成需另做业务验收；连同原因与版本读取状态，进度期限不自动提供回滚。

item.title: 文件没有提交到 Git，构建上下文里就没有它吗？
item.description: Git 忽略不控制 Docker 上下文；核对实际目录、忽略规则优先级与例外，并单独检查镜像产物。

item.title: 浏览器校验通过，服务端还要检查什么？
item.description: 浏览器校验用于及时反馈，服务端仍需核对格式、授权和当前业务状态，并提供可修正的错误。

item.title: 上游超时了，下游任务为什么仍在消耗资源？
item.description: 上游超时不证明下游停止：传播剩余预算，让执行器响应取消，并单独处理已经提交的业务副作用。

item.title: 断点续传怎样避免拼接两个版本的文件？
item.description: 断点续传应绑定表示版本，核对响应范围；完整响应进入替换流程，避免把不同版本的字节拼在一起。

item.title: JWT 签名正确，为什么仍可能用错了令牌？
item.description: JWT 签名有效仍需验证发行者、接受方与用途，认证之后还要检查资源权限，避免令牌跨用途混用。

item.title: 密码哈希要升级，为什么不能只替换算法名字？
item.description: 密码哈希升级需保留旧验证路径，确认新记录持久化，并评估长期未登录账户、并发改密和回滚兼容。

item.title: 点击成功后立刻断言，测试为什么偶尔失败？
item.description: 点击结束不证明业务完成；等待可重读的结果条件，区分短暂提示、持久状态与失败路径。

item.title: 国际化不能只给英文单词加一个 s
item.description: 复数类别负责选择消息，完整句子仍需翻译；区分基数、序数、零状态与未知数量。

item.title: 同一事务里时间没变，是数据库时钟停了吗？
item.description: CURRENT_TIMESTAMP 不变源于事务时间语义；按业务事件选择取时点，避免把时间戳当成全局顺序。

item.title: 外键能级联删除，业务就应该级联吗？
item.description: 根据对象所有权与生命周期选择外键删除动作，审查共享引用、软删除规则与恢复边界。

item.title: 保存点让导入继续了，怎样说明哪些记录失败？
item.description: 保存点只恢复局部改动，部分导入仍需明确外层提交、稳定记录身份、失败报告与重试契约。

item.title: 复盘写了改进项，怎样确认它真的降低了风险？
item.description: 复盘改进项应关联失败路径与可推翻完成判断的验收证据，区分任务关闭、检测改进和风险降低。

item.title: 扩大 fixture 作用域，测试为何开始互相影响？
item.description: 扩大 fixture 作用域也扩大共享状态寿命；分离昂贵资源与测试上下文，检查失败清理和并行外部资源。

item.title: OIDC removes stored cloud keys, not the need for narrow trust
item.description: Narrow workflow trust and cloud roles, accounting for repository subject-format changes and approval paths.

item.title: Prometheus for keeps restarting when each value creates a new alert identity
item.description: Trace changing value labels through pending, move display measurements into annotations, and separate rule timers from Alertmanager grouping.

item.title: A complete Deployment rollout still needs business acceptance
item.description: Separate version identity, controller completion and business acceptance; progress deadlines only signal stalled rollout.

item.title: Git ignore rules do not define the Docker build context
item.description: Inspect actual context sources, ignore precedence and exceptions, then verify build artifacts separately.

item.title: What the server must check after browser validation passes
item.description: Keep immediate input feedback separate from server authorization and current-state acceptance.

item.title: Why downstream work can survive an upstream timeout
item.description: Propagate remaining budgets, stop spawned work and handle committed effects separately from RPC cancellation.

item.title: Resuming a download without joining two file versions
item.description: Bind saved bytes to a representation and separate append, replacement and integrity checks.

item.title: A valid JWT signature does not establish the intended recipient
item.description: Validate intended issuer, audience and purpose, then authorize the requested resource separately.

item.title: Password-hash upgrades need a migration path, not just a new name
item.description: Plan legacy verification, authenticated upgrades, dormant-account recovery and rollback compatibility together.

item.title: A completed click is not a completed business operation
item.description: Wait for rereadable business outcomes rather than treating a completed click or transient notice as durable success.

item.title: Plural rules select categories, not translated sentences
item.description: Select complete localized messages, keeping cardinal, ordinal, zero-state and unknown-count semantics distinct.

item.title: An unchanged transaction timestamp is not a stopped clock
item.description: Match transaction, statement and observation timestamps to the event each field is meant to record.

item.title: Choose cascading deletion from ownership, not convenience
item.description: Choose referential deletion from lifetimes, shared references and recovery requirements.

item.title: Savepoints do not replace a partial-import report
item.description: Partial imports need stable input identities and trustworthy commit reports beyond local savepoint recovery.

item.title: An incident action closes when its risk reduction is checked
item.description: Tie incident actions to failure paths and falsifiable acceptance, without equating closed tasks with quantified risk reduction.

item.title: A broader fixture scope also broadens shared state
item.description: Broader fixture reuse needs explicit initial state, failure cleanup and external-resource isolation.

item.title: 发现阶段结束，不一定意味着进入开发
item.description: 发现阶段需要同时定义继续与停止条件，以问题、约束和关键未知决定是否进入下一步，而非为既定方案补报告。

item.title: 接口返回 202，什么时候才能说任务完成？
item.description: 202 表示接受而非完成；异步接口还需定义接受承诺、终态查询、授权和超时恢复，避免把提交成功误作业务完成。

item.title: 错误信息可读，客户端为什么仍无法采取动作？
item.description: HTTP 问题详情应区分稳定机器类型与可读说明，核对状态、权限和未知类型处理，不公开底层调试细节。

item.title: 只招熟悉产品的人，研究会漏掉什么？
item.description: 招募覆盖怎样影响研究结论：区分可接触用户与目标人群，记录失败者、支持需求和证据缺口。

item.title: Ending discovery can justify stopping rather than starting development
item.description: Define continuation and stopping conditions from the problem, constraints and decisive unknowns.

item.title: HTTP 202 acknowledges processing, not a completed business result
item.description: HTTP 202 needs an explicit acceptance promise, terminal-state retrieval, authorization and uncertainty recovery.

item.title: Error text needs a stable machine-readable decision boundary
item.description: Separate stable problem types from readable detail and verify status, permissions and unknown-type handling.

item.title: Research only with familiar users leaves predictable gaps
item.description: Recruit beyond familiar users, preserve unsuccessful journeys and report who remains outside the evidence.

item.title: 下载到了构建产物，怎样确认它就是本次批准的版本？
item.description: GitHub Actions 产物交接应绑定运行身份、不可变产物与摘要，摘要匹配只证明内容关联，不替代来源和发布授权。

item.title: 架构决定变了，旧 ADR 应该删除吗？
item.description: 旧 ADR 应保留原始背景并明确标记替代关系，把当前决定、迁移状态与重新评估条件分开记录。

item.title: CSP 报告没有告警，就能直接切到强制阻断吗？
item.description: CSP 观察模式不执行该策略的阻断；报告为空需先验证采集与业务覆盖，再灰度核验执行策略及回退。

item.title: Cookie 配了 SameSite，还需要 CSRF 防护吗？
item.description: SameSite 应结合应用条件评估，自动携带身份的写入请求仍需核对令牌、来源和子域信任边界。

item.title: 用了 Docker secret mount，镜像里就绝不会泄露密钥吗？
item.description: Docker 构建密钥挂载保护输入通道，仍需审查命令输出、生成文件、镜像层和缓存，防止进程主动复制秘密。

item.title: 排查需要上下文，怎样避免日志变成第二份敏感数据库？
item.description: 日志应记录操作、授权结果与关联标识，限制原始凭据和个人资料，并核对采集前脱敏、访问权限与保留范围。

item.title: 弹窗能关闭，键盘用户为什么找不到原来的位置？
item.description: 模态弹窗需定义焦点进入、内部循环和退出后的逻辑位置；ARIA 标记必须与真实交互行为一致。

item.title: 写了 readOnly，服务端就会拒绝修改吗？
item.description: OpenAPI 3.1.1 的 readOnly 是注解，业务接口仍需明确忽略或拒绝策略，并在实际写入路径验证受保护字段。

item.title: 改用尾部采样，就能找回已经丢掉的错误链路吗？
item.description: OpenTelemetry 尾部采样只能判断收到的数据；头部丢弃、路由分散和等待窗口都会影响错误链路保留，需要同时验证资源与完整性。

item.title: 加了行锁仍然死锁：所有入口是否按同一顺序拿锁？
item.description: PostgreSQL 18 会中止死锁中的一个事务；一致拿锁顺序需要覆盖全部写入入口，重试应回到完整业务事务边界。

item.title: JSONB 有 GIN 索引，为什么键存在查询仍可能用不上？
item.description: PostgreSQL 18 的 JSONB 索引选择需核对操作符类、表达式和业务查询，不能把更小的索引当成覆盖全部请求的保证。

item.title: 翻页有重复：LIMIT 之外还要约定什么？
item.description: PostgreSQL 18 的 LIMIT 需要唯一排序；游标减少位置漂移，但稳定数据导出仍需额外定义快照和可变排序字段。

item.title: 唯一约束存在，为什么还能保存两个空值？
item.description: PostgreSQL 18 默认把唯一约束中的 NULL 视为不同值，业务需明确未知、未分配与空字符串的含义再选择约束。

item.title: 点击增加了，任务完成了吗？产品指标先定义分母
item.description: 产品指标先定义用户收益、尝试单位和完成条件，保留跨日、重试与线下结果，避免点击增长掩盖任务失败。

item.title: 每个订单都加一个指标标签，排查会更方便吗？
item.description: Prometheus 标签组合会增加时间序列，订单与用户等无界维度应先估算增长，再用聚合指标与事件记录分担排查职责。

item.title: Promise.all 已经失败，其他请求为什么还在执行？
item.description: Promise.all 聚合失败不会取消已经开始的任务；需区分可取消读取、业务写入与完整结果收集，避免重试重复副作用。

item.title: Terraform 状态锁拿到了，云资源就不会被别人修改吗？
item.description: Terraform 状态锁协调同一状态的写入，不等于禁止控制台或其他状态修改资源；解锁前必须确认实际拥有者和运行结果。

item.title: 时间戳带了时区偏移，能表达每天九点吗？
item.description: 一次发生的时间与重复日历规则应分开保存，时间戳中的偏移不能独自定义未来本地时间的执行意图。

item.title: 上传接口只收图片，扩展名和 MIME 检查够吗？
item.description: 上传文件应先进入隔离状态，结合类型、解析资源、存储位置与下载授权检查，避免把入口判断当成全程安全。

item.title: 演示顺利不等于用户会用：怎样写不泄露答案的测试任务
item.description: 可用性测试应给出真实目标而非操作提示，分别记录独立完成、主持人帮助与错误恢复，再决定修复优先级。

item.title: Downloading an artifact is not proof it is the approved build
item.description: Bind approval to a specific workflow run and artifact digest, then verify that same object at deployment.

item.title: When architecture changes, keep the superseded ADR
item.description: Preserve the old decision, link its replacement, and separate architectural intent from migration completion.

item.title: No CSP reports does not prove an enforcement policy is ready
item.description: Verify reporting and workflow coverage before enforcing CSP; an empty report stream is not proof of safety.

item.title: Is SameSite alone enough to prevent CSRF?
item.description: Evaluate SameSite against the application threat model and protect state-changing requests with explicit checks.

item.title: A Docker secret mount cannot prevent a command from leaking its input
item.description: Secret mounts protect a build input channel; inspect commands, output files and caches for copied credentials.

item.title: Keep diagnostic evidence without creating a second sensitive database
item.description: Log decisions and correlation identifiers while controlling sensitive fields, access and retention.

item.title: A dialog can close while leaving keyboard users lost
item.description: Define dialog entry, contained keyboard navigation and the next focus destination, matching semantics to behavior.

item.title: Does readOnly in OpenAPI actually prevent a write?
item.description: In OpenAPI 3.1.1, readOnly is an annotation; define and verify the actual server-side write policy.

item.title: Tail sampling cannot recover traces already discarded upstream
item.description: Tail sampling selects received traces; upstream drops, routing and decision windows still constrain error coverage.

item.title: Row locks can still deadlock: order resources across every entry point
item.description: Prevent PostgreSQL deadlocks with consistent resource ordering across writers, and retry at the transaction boundary.

item.title: A JSONB GIN index does not support every query shape
item.description: Match PostgreSQL JSONB operator classes and indexed expressions to real queries before evaluating cost.

item.title: Pagination needs a unique order and a cross-page consistency policy
item.description: Use a unique order for PostgreSQL pagination, and define what concurrent changes may do between pages.

item.title: Why can a unique column still contain multiple NULLs?
item.description: PostgreSQL 18 treats NULLs as distinct in unique constraints by default; choose semantics before enforcing identity.

item.title: More clicks, fewer completed tasks? Define the denominator first
item.description: Define attempts, completion and observation windows before interpreting a rise in product clicks.

item.title: One metric label per order turns monitoring into an event database
item.description: Budget label combinations before exposing metrics, and keep unbounded event identities in suitable diagnostic storage.

item.title: Promise.all rejection does not cancel the remaining work
item.description: Promise.all aggregates outcomes; cancellation, compensation and complete result collection need separate policies.

item.title: Terraform state locking does not freeze the cloud
item.description: State locking coordinates a state backend, not every cloud writer; establish ownership before clearing a lock.

item.description: 解决 Error: ENOSPC: System limit for number of file watchers reached 原因： linux下系统程序监视超出了默认限制大小，需要手动设置。 查询当前系统限额： ``` cd /proc/sys/fs/inotify // 进入系统监控目录 ls // 显示当前文件夹下的文件 cat ./max_user_watches // 查看当前系统用户最大限额 ``` 解决方案： 临时扩容： ``` sudo sysctl fs.inotify.max_user_watches = 524288 //
